alra.external_policy: Fit ALRA separately on each corrupted external cohort using x only and the same pinned source.
alra.input: Frozen corrupted normalized log1p(CP10K) x, cells as rows and genes as columns.
alra.rank_policy: Use the implementation automatic choose_k procedure separately on each corrupted cohort. No target-based ALRA rank tuning.

knn.algorithm: sklearn.neighbors.NearestNeighbors with cosine distance and brute-force search; query cell itself is excluded from its neighbor set.
knn.hyperparameter_selection: Choose ONE common k across mask15, mask30, and mask50 that maximizes mean validation recovery index R=1-MSE/Var(masked_target). Ties choose smaller k.
knn.repair_score: Fraction of the k neighbors with expression >1e-8 at that gene.
knn.test_external_fit: Refit neighbor search separately on each corrupted test or external cohort using x only.
knn.value_prediction: Arithmetic mean of the k neighbor corrupted expression values at each gene.

positive_train_mean.fit_data: Only log1p matrices from manifest records with split=train and modality=sc.
positive_train_mean.repair_score: Per-gene positive prevalence: positive training cell count divided by total training cell count.
positive_train_mean.value_prediction: Per-gene arithmetic mean over strictly positive training log1p values.

positive_train_median.fit_data: Only log1p matrices from manifest records with split=train and modality=sc.
positive_train_median.repair_score: Per-gene positive prevalence: positive training cell count divided by total training cell count.
positive_train_median.value_prediction: Per-gene median over strictly positive training log1p values.

scvi.external_policy: Fit a new unsupervised scVI model separately on each corrupted external cohort and mask panel, with frozen architecture and seed policy; never use masked y.
scvi.hyperparameter_selection: At tuning seed 20260728, choose ONE common n_latent across mask15, mask30, and mask50 maximizing mean validation recovery index R. Ties choose smaller n_latent.
scvi.input: Aligned raw-count view of the exact frozen cells and 4096 genes. Exact synthetic_mask count positions are set to zero. Frozen log1p panels are not used as scVI training counts.
scvi.prediction: Use get_normalized_expression(library_size=10000, return_numpy=True), then apply np.log1p to place predictions on the frozen evaluation scale.
scvi.repair_score: Same log1p decoded normalized expression value.

training.all_other_training_options: Use defaults of pinned scvi-tools version unless an option is required for deterministic device or seed selection; any such execution option must be recorded in the pre-result environment receipt.

scvi.value_prediction: log1p of scVI decoded expression scaled to library_size=10000.

truncated_low_rank.algorithm: sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd on x without centering; reconstruction=(U*S)@Vt; clamp negative reconstructed values to zero.
truncated_low_rank.hyperparameter_selection: Choose ONE common rank across mask15, mask30, and mask50 that maximizes mean validation recovery index R=1-MSE/Var(masked_target). Ties choose smaller rank.
truncated_low_rank.test_external_fit: Refit the frozen-rank decomposition separately on each corrupted test or external cohort using x only.

execution_order.1: Commit this scientific protocol before any p2 comparator statistic, fit, prediction, or evaluation is produced.
execution_order.2: Create isolated ALRA and scVI environments and commit an environment and source receipt before comparator inference.
execution_order.3: Derive train-only positive statistics and tune deterministic comparator hyperparameters on frozen internal validation.
execution_order.4: Tune scVI n_latent on internal validation using only the predeclared tuning seed.
execution_order.5: Freeze all selected hyperparameters and comparator thresholds in a second pre-test selection receipt.
execution_order.6: Only then evaluate frozen internal test and external panels.

frozen_corpus.normalization: raw counts -> frozen 4096-gene projection -> CP10K using projected 4096-gene row sum -> log1p

frozen_internal_benchmarks.selection_policy: Comparator hyperparameters and repair thresholds may use validation panels only. Frozen test panels are evaluated only after method-specific validation choices are frozen.

labels_and_eligibility.external_available_gene_mask: Use frozen available_gene_mask from each external panel. Unavailable genes are never counted as true zeros, masked positives, gate/selective candidates, or preservation entries.

prohibited_actions: No comparator hyperparameter selection using internal test.
No comparator threshold selection using internal test.
No comparator threshold or hyperparameter tuning using external labels.
No use of masked y during transductive comparator fitting.
No alteration of Zheng68K or Baron mappings or preprocessing.
No treatment of unavailable external genes as biological true zeros.
No regeneration of frozen p1 internal or external normalized panels.
No comparator result may be inspected before this protocol is committed.

reconstruction_policy.replacement_rule: Only available positions with abs(x)<=1e-8 and repair_score>=frozen_threshold may be replaced by the comparator value prediction.
reconstruction_policy.required_preservation_result: All observed-nonzero reconstruction errors must be exactly 0.

selective_repair_policy.curve_reporting: Save recall-versus-true-zero-fill and risk-versus-coverage curves across the full score range. Operating-point selection uses exact score boundaries; presentation curves may be downsampled deterministically to at most 201 points plus the exact selected point.
selective_repair_policy.deterministic_method_thresholds: One frozen threshold per method per mask rate.
selective_repair_policy.scvi_common_threshold: After n_latent is frozen, choose one common threshold per mask across the three confirmatory scVI validation seeds, maximizing mean recall subject to true_zero_fill <=0.02 in EVERY seed. Break ties by mean precision then stricter or higher threshold.
selective_repair_policy.threshold_search: For each comparator and mask rate, search exact distinct validation score boundaries plus a no-selection sentinel. Select the threshold maximizing masked-positive recall subject to true_zero_fill<=0.02. Break ties by higher precision, then stricter or higher threshold.

v1_immutability.rule: The completed SC2 p1 confirmatory chain is immutable. No p1 checkpoint, threshold, internal panel, external panel, mapping, preprocessing rule, or external cell selection may change as part of p2.
v1_immutability.sc2_curve_policy: Reuse existing p1 step-4000 validation, test, and external summary, threshold_sweep, and risk_coverage artefacts. Do not rerun or reselect the p1 SC2 operating point.

value_metric_policy.evaluation_positions: All frozen masked-positive positions, restricted to available genes externally.
